title: Alt Text Evaluation Dashboard
tagline: A web-based visualization to support a mixed-methods study on AI-in-the-loop alt-text authorship
summary: is a web-based evaluative dashboard for a multimodal research dataset supporting a 2025-2026 independent study on AI-in-the-loop alt-text authorship and cultural heritage sites.

title: TravelMate
tagline: An interactive travel planning web application
summary: is an interactive travel planning web application built with Django and HTML. Users input their dates, destination, and activities to receive custom AI and API powered weather forecasts, packing lists, and additional travel tips.

title: Poetic Alt Text Resource
tagline: A web-based reference on creative and poetic alt text authorship developed for the Fulton County Public Art Futures Lab
summary: is a supplementary resource for the Fulton County Public Art Futures Lab and featured in their celebration of the 36th Anniversary of the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA).

title: Black Women's Cambridge
tagline: A research-through-design study apply Black feminist geographies to Critical GIS
summary: is a research-through-design study examining how visualizing Black feminist geographies challenges the positivist design assumptions of ArcGIS. It was conducted during the 2026 MIT Summer Research Program

title: 'Uninvited Guests' Advertisement
tagline: A design fiction advertisement based on a speculative film about assistive technologies, elder care, and autonomy
summary: is a design fiction artifact reimagining the 2015 speculative film, Uninvited Guests, from the design firm Superflux.

title: Potluck
tagline: A social media app to foster cultural connection through food for minority college students
summary: is a mobile UX prototype of a culturally-responsive, culinary-centric social media app intended to bolster community international, first/second-gen, and racial/ethnic minority students on college campuses.
